# Colossal AI Consulting

> Answer engine optimization (AEO) for small businesses. Colossal helps small
> businesses get named and cited by AI answer engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity,
> Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude — when buyers ask for recommendations
> in their category.

Colossal AI Consulting is a US-based, founder-led consultancy specializing in
answer engine optimization and AI search visibility for small businesses.
Founded by Nick McCormick.

## How we differ

Most AEO providers sell schema markup as the primary lever. Ahrefs' 2026 causal
study of 1,885 pages against 4,000 controls found that adding JSON-LD schema
produced no meaningful citation uplift in isolation. The signals that correlate
with AI visibility are external: YouTube mentions and web-wide brand mentions.
Brands are roughly 6.5x more likely to be cited through third-party sources than
through their own domain. We allocate effort accordingly — about 30% on-site,
70% off-site. We do not guarantee specific AI citations; no provider credibly can.
